description: Binary assertions for ZoneWise Scraper V4 output quality. Used by Karpathy-style self-improvement loop.

tests.prompt: Scrape zoning data for Brevard County, FL. Output structured JSON for the first 10 parcels.
tests.expected_output: Structured JSON array of zoning records with valid parcel IDs and zone codes

assertions.description: Output is valid JSON (parseable without errors)
Every record contains a parcel_id field matching Brevard format (##-##-##-##-#####.#-####.#)
Every record contains a non-null zone_code field
Every record contains a non-null zone_name field
zone_code values match known Brevard zoning codes (BU, GU, RS, RU, AU, IU, PUD, etc.)

tests.prompt: Run county-wide spatial join for Brevard using STRtree bulk method. Report match statistics.
tests.expected_output: Spatial join results with match rate and unmatched parcel list

assertions.description: Output includes total_parcels as integer > 0
Output includes matched_parcels as integer > 0
Match rate (matched/total) is >= 0.95 (95%)
Output includes unmatched_parcels array (even if empty)
Processing time is reported in seconds as numeric value

tests.prompt: Run municipal conquest for Palm Bay using BCPAO centroids SR2881 against gis.palmbayflorida.org Zoning/MapServer/0.
tests.expected_output: Municipal zoning data with city-specific zone codes and match statistics

assertions.description: Output contains municipality field set to 'Palm Bay'
Output contains gis_source URL pointing to gis.palmbayflorida.org
No records use USE_CODE mapping (must use city's native zoning field)
Total matched parcels > 50000 (Palm Bay has ~78K parcels)
Every zoning record includes both zone_code and zone_description

tests.prompt: Persist 10 zoning records to Supabase. Verify data integrity after write.
tests.expected_output: Supabase upsert confirmation with row count and integrity check

assertions.description: Supabase upsert returns status 200 or 201
Returned row count matches input count (10)
No duplicate parcel_ids in output (all unique)
Every record has a created_at timestamp in ISO 8601 format
county field is lowercase string matching source county

tests.prompt: Attempt to scrape a non-existent county 'Fakeland'. Verify graceful error handling.
tests.expected_output: Structured error response with error code and message

assertions.description: Output contains error field (not a stack trace)
Error message is human-readable (no raw Python tracebacks)
Output does not contain null or undefined top-level fields
Exit code is non-zero (1 or 2)
Output is valid JSON even in error state
